comparison.objective: Extract a jammed card intact with both hands and resume printing.
comparison.physical_skill: Symmetric two-hand pulling that prevents skew and tearing, followed by button operation.
comparison.success_condition: Card removed whole and placed down; resume button pressed; hands clear.
comparison.reason: Balanced extraction of a deformable, tearable sheet differs from advancing a rigid carriage across a precisely butted guide while containing independent balls.
